title: Codex Deck button settings
description: Include slots 1 through 5 exactly once. Legacy 1–3 files are accepted for automatic migration; the app checks slot uniqueness.

slot.description: Maps the button position and Command-Control-number shortcut. Include 1 through 5 exactly once; array order does not matter.

model.description: Model label shown in Codex's picker. Matching ignores GPT prefix, case, spacing and punctuation; gpt-6-astra and gpt-6.1-sol also match their display names.

label.description: Optional name on the Web Deck button, such as Focus or Fast. Model and effort still control the actual selection. Omit for an automatic model-family name.
